task.title: Stale intermediate value at output sink
task.problem_statement: Trace the discounted intermediate through invoice_total and determine whether the return value implements the declared formula.
constraints: Trace values from definition to sink.
Do not infer correctness from the existence of an intermediate variable.

expected_findings.statement: The function computes subtotal minus discount but returns the original subtotal plus tax, so the discounted value does not reach the output sink.
supporting_evidence: AST shows discounted assignment and return expression using subtotal.
Runtime output is 105 while declared expected value is 95.
counterevidence: Synthetic fixture only; not an upstream production defect.
acceptable_alternatives: Identify the stale-value path and distinguish it from arithmetic or input-contract uncertainty.

verification.method: Pinned AST and runtime fixture verification; independent adjudication pending.
